info.description:
IRIS API endpoints documentation. An API key is needed and can be found in every user profile under `My settings` > `API Key`. 

Updated to support Alerts which came out in API v2.0.2
info.title: IRIS v2

post.description: Create an asset and link it to the case.
Delete an asset for the case. If the asset is linked in an event, the reference is also removed.

get.description: Get a list of the assets linked to the case.
Fetch the content of an asset

post.description: Link a new evidence to the case

get.description: Remove an evidence from the case.
Returns a list of all evidences
Returns information of a specific evidence
Export a case in JSON format including all the information such as assets, iocs, etc.

parameters.description: ID Of the case to export
parameters.name: cid

get.description: Delete an IOC from the case. If the IOC is still reference in other cases than it's only unlinked from the current case.
Returns a list of IOCs as well as any existing linked with other cases.
Fetch the content of an ioc

post.description: Add a new note to an existing group.

get.description: Delete the content of a note.
Get a list of the notes and groups
get.summary: Get list of groups and notes

get.description: Delete a group with all notes linked to it. It is not possible to recover deleted notes.

post.description: Update the content of a note.
Search in notes. The searched term is a wild carded.

get.description: Fetch the content and information of a note

post.description: Update the summary of a case. Attention this will trigger an overwrite of the summary. Summaries are shared interactively between users. If an update summary is issue, every user will receive the change and their locale changes will be lost.
Add a task log to the case. The task log is registered under Activities and is be availble in reports templating.

get.description: Delete a case task
Return information of a specific task

post.description: Create a new event in the timeline

get.description: Delete an event from the timeline

post.description: Update an event in the timeline

get.description: Return information of an event of the timeline
Fetch the timeline of a case. asset_id allows to filter on a particular asset. If set to 0, all events are returned.
Fetch the state of the timeline.

post.description: Add a new customer that will be availble at case creations.
Add a global task and assign it to a user.

get.description: Get a list of the global tasks

post.description: Update the status of a global task.
Create a new immediate case. If cid is not set, a default case is used. This does not change the behavior of the request and is only used for internal tracking.

get.description: Close a case. The case will be listed under closed case. That's the only difference with an open case. It will stay editable and searchable.

Delete a case. This implies the deletion of everything linked to the case including summary, assets, notes, timeline, tasks and evidences. The IOCs will only be deleted if they are not referenced in another case.
Returns a list of all the cases, open and closed.
Reopen a case previously closed. A case can be reopened if it is not closed.
Only users that never done any activities can be deleted. This is to prevent any internal logic errors and keep tracks of every past activities.
Returns information of a specific user
